card.name: Possessives before family-member words
card.fires_on: Possessive words like his, her, their and the, right where a family noun such as father, mother, son or parents is about to come next. Seen in biographical and narrative web text.

modes.label: Possessive before parent
modes.description: His or her sits just before father or mother.

modes.label: Possessive before child or family
modes.description: His, her or their sits before son, family or parents.

modes.label: The before father
modes.description: The article appears where father is expected next.

card.writes: It lowers the chance of grandparent words, so the model favors other family terms such as father, mother or son.
card.plain: It fires on his or her when a relative like father, mother or son is about to be named.
